The '''Red Band Rebels''' was an organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cadinth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Doctor/Legends|combat surgeon]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc, worked with the Rebels for a time.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fashaka was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
